primary: owned-15 mean realised net points per GW, equal neutral scenario weights
reference: incumbent method; do not select a reference after results

scenarios.common_sampling_weight: (price_tenths/50)^2 before stratum weighting; source-only budget-feasibility correction

secondary: six causal quote-ledger rolling paths, one-GW policy
policy: max XI means plus captain plus 0.1 reserve means less 4 per excess transfer; bench/vice descending mean with stable ID ties
finances: snapshot quotes, 1000 initial capital, 1 initial FT, bank max5, half-profit selling; no chips or hindsight future prices

inference.method: season-local contiguous-segment circular blocks; average scenarios within GW; simultaneous centred maximum absolute deviation across reference comparisons

rolling_inference: whole path totals and scenario sensitivity; no independent-episode CI
admission: only verified club-calendar blanks are zero; missing held-player/market forecast fails whole run, never silently drops a model or favourable path
original_archive: 2024 original Dastan separate conditional weekly owned panels, lower cost bound0, no reset/rolling, original forecasts retained; no information parity claim
small_archive: original external single GW separate posthoc diagnostic only; no GW inference or pooling
claim_limits: historical outcomes already inspected; descriptive, no full-season/chip superiority or model promotion; no parameter search
revision_note: v1 sampling exhausted before any new selection scores; failed run retained; no outcome-based policy choice
